mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper reports retained antimicrobial activity and comparable time-kill kinetics for danalexin versus ranalexin, and frames this as consistent with the anticipated nonspecific pore-formation mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No direct pore-formation assay in this paper; final ontology does not claim direct_mechanism.

caution_findings.note: The paper discusses pore formation as the anticipated mechanism and provides phenotype/time-kill evidence; no direct molecular pore assay is promoted to direct_mechanism.
